# Step - export_graphml

`export_graphml` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Writes the whole graph to a GraphML file at the given path (needs file access).

## Forms

```text
export_graphml(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai
g.export_graphml("modern.graphml")
```
